Hi! I'm Andree, an epidemiologist from Peru working in outbreak analytics, serology, and health data science. I bridge epidemiology and quantitative methods to make outbreak response more accessible through teaching and open science.

Most recently, at the **London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine (LSHTM)**, I developed and organised the short course on outbreak analytics and applied modelling in R, building on the tutorials and how-to guides I wrote for the Epiverse-TRACE project. I've trained **over 300 epidemiologists across five continents**.

I also **develop and contribute to R packages** that help field epidemiologists analyse line lists, social contact surveys, and serological data to produce real-time estimates and scenarios. I'm open to consultancies and roles in infectious disease epidemiology and training, in Peru or remotely. [Let's connect](mailto:andree.valle-campos@outlook.com).
